attributes.name: Guardian Thunderbird
attributes.powers:
The Guardian Thunderbird is immune to the Electricity trait. All damage dealt by the Guardian Thunderbird is Electricity damage.

Before you act, a random character at your location is dealt 1d4 Electricity damage.

If the check to defeat has the Ranged trait, the difficulty is increased by 3.
